messages:
Alex Chen: Quick check-in — hotpath perf sprint status. I pushed the microbatch kernel PR this morning (WIP: uses new slot allocator). Can owners confirm CI + perf run? @Priya @Mateo
Priya Nair: Saw the PR, skimmed. CI is green but perf-run shows a ~3% regression on 512-token median for long-seqs. digging now.
Mateo Ruiz: I ran a local profile — regression looks tied to the new free-list path in slot allocator. Might be a cacheline thrash when evicting KV entries.
Jing Park: Re: KV evict, are we still using the old LRU fallback? If so we should gate the new allocator behind the feature flag until we fix eviction jitter.
Alex Chen: Good call. I'll flip the flag to off in the canary: `RUNTIME_MICROBATCH_ALLOC=off` for tonight's run.
Samir Patel: Tagging eng-infra since the nightly perf cluster had two preemptions last night that could affect medians. @eng-infra 
deploy-bot: nightly-perf-run started: run_id=perf-2026-03-15-02, target=canary, profiles=long-seq,short-seq.
Priya Nair: Results landed: short-seq stable, long-seq median regressed 3.2%. Allocator path shows spikes on kv_evict(), sample trace:```
kv_evict()@0x7f1a3
slot_free_slowpath()@0x7f2b1
memmove@libc
```
Mateo Ruiz: That memmove indicates we're shuffling large chunks on eviction. Could switch to pointer swap + tombstone and delayed reclaim. I'll prototype.
Jing Park: Prototype idea: mark slot tombstone, lazy-compact when free-ratio > 20%. That avoids memmove for high churn. Might increase peak memory. Need numbers.
Alex Chen: If prototype looks good, we can A/B with canary routing: 10% traffic -> new allocator + tombstone, 90% -> old. We should create a rollout plan doc and add rollback test.
Samir Patel: Putting the infra dependency explicitly: need a one-off node pool without preemptions for the A/B (request submitted to eng-infra). ETA 2d for pool.
Mateo Ruiz: I have a quick patch that replaces memmove with pointer swap + mark; bench shows 1.7% improvement on synthetic high-churn. Will open PR with test cases this afternoon.
Priya Nair: Also noticed continuous batching queue sometimes holds stale prefixes when KV warmup fails; adding a guard in the hotpath: `if (!kv_warmup_ok) skip_continuous_batching()` — will draft a tiny change.
Alex Chen: Good. Can we list owners for rollout: microbatch kernel -> Mateo; allocator tombstone -> Mateo/Jing; KV warmup guard -> Priya; canary infra -> Samir. I'll add to the sprint board.
Jing Park: Clarifying deps: microbatch kernel PR needs eng-platform review for scheduling contract. Pinged @eng-platform in that PR.
Samir Patel: Eng-infra approved the one-off pool, but asked for a test harness to simulate preemption-less load. I'll coordinate and share scripts.
Priya Nair: Code review pings: @Mateo your PR needs unit tests for eviction counters; @Alex can you add a short README describing the feature flag behavior?
Mateo Ruiz: Will add tests + counters, targetting by EOD PDT.
Alex Chen: I'll add README and rollout steps. Plan: open canary tomorrow morning, run perf for 4h, evaluate long-seq and tail p95, if stable -> 50% for 24h, else rollback.
Priya Nair: Capturing acceptance criteria: long-seq median within +/-1% of baseline, p95 <= baseline + 2%, and no more than 0.5% increase in memory footprint on avg.
Jing Park: LGTM on criteria. Also add a quick smoke-check script that validates KV hit-rate >= 95% for the first 10k requests.
deploy-bot: perf-run perf-2026-03-15-02 completed. Artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/perf-2026-03-15-02.zip
Alex Chen: Thanks everyone. I'll post the rollout doc and update the sprint board. If anyone hits a blocker ping here. :thumbsup:
